moses.name: Moses
moses.role: Prophet who leads Israel from Egypt
moses.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
moses.importance: He speaks to Israel in Moab before they cross the Jordan. He tells their past again and teaches the law. He writes the law, lays his hands on Joshua, and blesses the tribes. He sees the land from Mount Nebo and dies in Moab.
moses.connections: Son of Amram and Jochebed. Brother of Aaron and Miriam. Husband of Zipporah.

aaron.name: Aaron
aaron.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
aaron.importance: Moses recalls the calf at Horeb. The LORD was angry enough to destroy Aaron, and Moses prayed for him. Aaron later died, and his son Eleazar became priest. The LORD tells Moses he will die as Aaron did.
aaron.connections: Son of Amram and Jochebed. Father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

miriam.name: Miriam
miriam.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
miriam.importance: Moses gives a rule about leprosy. Then he says, “Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam.” He does not tell her story here.
miriam.connections: Sister of Moses and Aaron. The watching sister in Exodus 2 is unnamed there.

joshua.name: Joshua
joshua.role: Son of Nun who will lead after Moses
joshua.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
joshua.importance: The LORD says Joshua will go into the land and tells Moses to encourage him. Moses tells him before all Israel to be strong. Moses lays his hands on him. After Moses dies, Israel listens to Joshua.
joshua.connections: Son of Nun. Moses lays his hands on him.

caleb.name: Caleb
caleb.role: Son of Jephunneh who will see the land
caleb.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
caleb.importance: Moses recalls the LORD’s oath after the people refused to go up. No man of that generation will see the land except Caleb. The LORD promises him the land he walked on, because he followed the LORD.
caleb.connections: Son of Jephunneh. The LORD names him just before Joshua the son of Nun.

dathan.name: Dathan
dathan.role: Son of Eliab swallowed by the earth
dathan.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
dathan.importance: Moses reminds Israel what the LORD did to Dathan and Abiram. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them. Moses says Israel saw the LORD’s work with their own eyes.
dathan.connections: Son of Eliab, from Reuben’s family. Brother of Abiram.

abiram.name: Abiram
abiram.role: Son of Eliab swallowed by the earth
abiram.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
abiram.importance: Moses names Abiram with his brother Dathan. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them both. Their households, tents, and followers went down with them.
abiram.connections: Son of Eliab, from Reuben’s family. Brother of Dathan.

balaam.name: Balaam
balaam.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
balaam.importance: A law keeps Ammonites and Moabites out of the LORD’s assembly. One reason is that they hired Balaam to curse Israel. The LORD would not listen to Balaam. He turned the curse into a blessing.
balaam.connections: Son of Beor, from Pethor of Mesopotamia. Balak hires him in Numbers 22.

sihon.name: Sihon
sihon.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
sihon.importance: Moses sends him words of peace and asks to pass through. Sihon refuses and comes out to fight at Jahaz. Israel takes all his cities. Moses gives that land to the Reubenites and the Gadites.
sihon.connections: He fights Moses and Israel. Og is the other Amorite king east of the Jordan.

og.name: Og
og.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
og.importance: Og comes out to fight Israel at Edrei. Israel defeats him and takes his sixty cities. Moses notes his iron bed, nine cubits long. Moses gives Bashan to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
og.connections: He fights Moses and Israel. Sihon is the other Amorite king east of the Jordan.

abraham.name: Abraham
abraham.role: First father to whom God swore the land
abraham.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
abraham.importance: The LORD swore to give the land to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Moses repeats this oath as Israel gets ready to enter. He also prays by their names when the LORD is angry (9:27). The LORD repeats the oath to Moses on Mount Nebo.
abraham.connections: Husband of Sarah. Father of Ishmael and Isaac. Uncle of Lot.

lot.name: Lot
lot.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
lot.importance: The LORD gave Ar to the children of Lot, who are Moab. He also gave the children of Ammon their land. So Israel must not fight them or take their land.
lot.connections: Son of Haran. Father of two daughters in Genesis 19.

isaac.name: Isaac
isaac.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
isaac.importance: Isaac never acts alone in this book. Moses names him with Abraham and Jacob each time. The LORD swore the land to all three.
isaac.connections: Husband of Rebekah. Father of Esau and Jacob.

esau.name: Esau
esau.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
esau.importance: Esau’s children live in Seir, and Moses calls them Israel’s brothers. The LORD gave Mount Seir to Esau. Israel must not fight them and must pay for food and water.
esau.connections: Twin brother of Jacob. Ancestor of Edom.

jacob.name: Jacob
jacob.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
jacob.importance: Moses names Jacob with Abraham and Isaac in the oath about the land. The poems in chapters 32–33 also call the people Jacob.
jacob.connections: Son of Isaac and Rebekah. Father of twelve sons and Dinah.

joseph.name: Joseph
joseph.role: Son of Jacob whose tribes carry his name
joseph.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
joseph.importance: Joseph’s tribe stands on Mount Gerizim to bless the people (chapter 27). Moses blesses Joseph’s land with dew, fruit, and the best of the hills. He says Joseph’s horns are like a wild ox’s. The horns are Ephraim and Manasseh.
joseph.connections: Son of Jacob and Rachel. Husband of Asenath. Father of Ephraim and Manasseh.

judah.name: Judah
judah.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
judah.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
judah.importance: Judah’s tribe stands on Mount Gerizim to bless the people (chapter 27). Moses asks the LORD to hear Judah’s voice. He asks the LORD to help Judah against his enemies.
judah.connections: Son of Jacob and Leah. Father of Perez and Zerah through Tamar.

reuben.name: Reuben
reuben.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
reuben.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
reuben.importance: Moses gives the Reubenites land east of the Jordan, taken from Sihon (chapter 3). The tribe stands on Mount Ebal for the curse (chapter 27). Moses prays, “Let Reuben live, and not die.”
reuben.connections: Son of Jacob and Leah. Brother of Joseph.

simeon.name: Simeon
simeon.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
simeon.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
simeon.importance: Simeon’s tribe stands on Mount Gerizim to bless the people. Moses does not name Simeon in the blessings of chapter 33.

levi.name: Levi
levi.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
levi.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
levi.importance: The LORD sets Levi’s tribe apart to carry the ark and serve him (chapter 10). Levi gets no land share, for the LORD is his share. The tribe stands on Mount Gerizim (chapter 27). Moses says they will teach Israel the law and offer sacrifices.

benjamin.name: Benjamin
benjamin.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
benjamin.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
benjamin.importance: Benjamin’s tribe stands on Mount Gerizim to bless the people (chapter 27). Moses calls Benjamin the beloved of the LORD. He says Benjamin will live in safety.
benjamin.connections: Son of Rachel. Full brother of Joseph.

ephraim.name: Ephraim
ephraim.role: Son of Joseph whose tribe carries his name
ephraim.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
ephraim.importance: Moses names Ephraim once, inside Joseph’s blessing. He says Joseph’s horns are “the ten thousands of Ephraim.” Ephraim gets no blessing of his own.
ephraim.connections: Son of Joseph and Asenath. Brother of Manasseh.

manasseh.name: Manasseh
manasseh.role: Son of Joseph whose tribe carries his name
manasseh.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
manasseh.importance: Moses gives the half-tribe of Manasseh the rest of Gilead and all Bashan. Jair the son of Manasseh takes the region of Argob. Joseph’s blessing ends with “the thousands of Manasseh.”
manasseh.connections: Son of Joseph and Asenath. Brother of Ephraim.

zebulun.name: Zebulun
zebulun.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
zebulun.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
zebulun.importance: Zebulun’s tribe stands on Mount Ebal for the curse (chapter 27). Moses tells Zebulun to rejoice in his going out. He says Zebulun and Issachar will call peoples to the mountain to offer sacrifices.
zebulun.connections: Son of Jacob and Leah. His name also identifies a later tribe.

issachar.name: Issachar
issachar.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
issachar.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
issachar.importance: Issachar’s tribe stands on Mount Gerizim to bless the people (chapter 27). Moses tells Issachar to rejoice in his tents. Issachar shares this blessing with Zebulun.
issachar.connections: Son of Jacob and Leah. His name also identifies a later tribe.

dan.name: Dan
dan.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
dan.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
dan.importance: Dan’s tribe stands on Mount Ebal for the curse (chapter 27). Moses calls Dan a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.
dan.connections: Son of Jacob and Bilhah. His name also identifies a later tribe.

naphtali.name: Naphtali
naphtali.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
naphtali.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
naphtali.importance: Naphtali’s tribe stands on Mount Ebal for the curse (chapter 27). Moses says Naphtali is full of the LORD’s blessing. He tells the tribe to possess the west and the south.
naphtali.connections: Son of Jacob and Bilhah. His name also identifies a later tribe.

gad.name: Gad
gad.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
gad.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
gad.importance: Moses gives the Gadites land east of the Jordan with the Reubenites (chapter 3). The tribe stands on Mount Ebal for the curse (chapter 27). Moses says Gad lives like a lioness and took the first part for himself.
gad.connections: Son of Jacob and Zilpah. His name also identifies a later tribe.

asher.name: Asher
asher.role: Son of Jacob whose tribe carries his name
asher.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
asher.importance: Asher’s tribe stands on Mount Ebal for the curse (chapter 27). Moses says Asher is blessed with children. He asks that Asher dip his foot in oil and stay strong all his days.
asher.connections: Son of Jacob and Zilpah. His name also identifies a later tribe.
